entities.name: Product
entities.purpose: A plan or support package that customers can subscribe to, with its category, visibility, billing type and pricing.
entities.model_notes: Collection name and camelCase document property names derived by the nosql convention and decided by Claude under user delegation (Q-022); change on request. For this nosql store 'column' holds the camelCase document property name; the API key stays PascalCase.
entities.system_of_record: Cosmos DB - products collection (Nebula store, to be created)
entities.velocity_rationale: Shared catalog of plans, not per customer; changes when plans or prices change (Q-010). Two-admin concurrent edits are not treated as contested.

entities.name: Customer
entities.purpose: A customer account that subscribes to products: contact details, Stripe customer reference, and an Active or Inactive status.
entities.model_notes: camelCase plural collection (same convention as products); property names camelCase, API keys PascalCase.
entities.system_of_record: Cosmos DB - customers collection (Nebula store, to be created)
entities.velocity_rationale: Data belongs to individual customers and is read per customer; status changes on explicit admin action (CR-001 interview).

state_machines.terminal_note: Not terminal: Inactive customers can be re-activated (control not shown in inputs, AS-26). Accepted exception to 'every stateful entity terminates'.

transitions.trigger: Admin confirms De-activate in the dialog
Re-activate (named in the dialog text; no control shown)

functional_requirements.text: The system shall list products as cards showing name, category, a visibility badge, price with its billing unit, and an Edit button.
The system shall filter the product cards by category (All, PaaS, Managed, with counts), by a Visibility filter, and by a name search.
An admin shall add a product through the product drawer, opened by Add product.
An admin shall edit a product through the same drawer, opened by Edit on its card, and save or cancel the change.
The form shall require Name, Category, No. of apps allowed, Visibility and Billing type, and limit Short description to 3000 characters.
The form shall show the recurring pricing (Stripe) panel when Billing type is Recurring and the one-time price when it is One time.
The Product Management Agent shall list, show, create and update products through the CRUD tools.
The system shall list customers on the left of a split view with a name search and a 'Show active customers only' toggle.
The system shall show the selected customer on the right: name, status, 'Customer since' date, and a contact card with contact name, email, phone and Stripe customer ID.
An admin shall de-activate an active customer through the De-activate dialog by giving a reason and an optional internal note and confirming; the customer's status becomes Inactive.
The dialog shall be dismissed without change by Cancel.
The Product Management Agent shall list and show customers and de-activate an active customer through the CRUD tools.

assumptions.text: Velocity layer is Slow.

assumptions.text: Tool prefix is np; operations are create, get, list and update through the API endpoints; there is no delete.

The agent converses with an admin to list, show, create and update products; model sonnet; one skill product-management.

assumptions.text: The panel title text is stored in sentence case; the preview styles it uppercase as in IN-02.
Data classification for Product is not decided.
The source of the Monthly and Yearly Stripe price options and any rule tying them to the USD prices are unknown; the dropdowns are non-functional.
Whether the drawer has fields below Script (AWS) is unknown; none are added.
The purpose and maximum length of the Script (Azure) and Script (AWS) fields are unknown; Script (Azure) is multi-line and Script (AWS) single-line as seen.

The card banner colour is presentational and not a stored field.
Who may view, add and edit products is unknown; no roles are defined and the CRUD access role is undecided.

New customers start as Active; Status is changed only by the De-activate action.

glossary.definition: A plan or support package customers can subscribe to (page subtitle in IN-01).
PaaS or Managed; also the All / PaaS / Managed tabs on the Products screen.
Public, Private or Draft; Public and Private appear as a badge on each card.
One time or Recurring; decides which pricing fields apply.
A Stripe price id (shown as price_...) chosen for the monthly or yearly price of a recurring product.
An account that subscribes to products; listed in the Customers split view.
Sets a customer's status to Inactive, with a reason and optional internal note.
